visualizations.title: n × 1 环面沙堆无论顺序都推倒 A023855(n − 1) 次
visualizations.title_en: The n × 1 torus sandpile topples A023855(n − 1) times in every order
visualizations.summary: OEIS A293452（Arndt，2017）统计环面沙堆的推倒次数：除 c[0,0] 外每格 4 粒，c[0,0] 只吞不吐，不少于 4 粒的格子减 4、四个邻居各加 1。条目猜想第一列 T(n,1) = A023855(n)，但印出的下标差了一位。本库在 Lean 里证明改正后的等式并已冻结：n ≥ 2 时，每个以终态结束的合法顺序都恰好推倒 A023855(n − 1) = Σ j(n − j) 次，每个格子恰好推倒 u(x) = (x(n − x) + [n 偶]·min(x, n − x))/2 次（最小作用与离散极大值原理）。页面把格子排成一圈，按五种规则一粒一粒地推倒，里圈的柱子总会停在同一条抛物线上。
visualizations.summary_en: OEIS A293452 (Arndt, 2017) counts the topplings of a torus sandpile: 4 grains on every cell except c[0,0], which only swallows grains, and a cell with at least 4 grains loses 4 and gives 1 to each of its four neighbours. The entry conjectures T(n,1) = A023855(n) for the first column, but the printed index is off by one. This library proves the corrected identity in Lean, frozen: for n ≥ 2 every legal order that ends in a final state topples exactly A023855(n − 1) = Σ j(n − j) times, and each cell exactly u(x) = (x(n − x) + [n even]·min(x, n − x))/2 times (least action and a discrete maximum principle). The page puts the cells on a ring and topples them grain by grain under five rules; the inner bars always end on the same parabola.

visualizations.title: 保真度测量的累积点不一定在最优 ROC 曲线上
visualizations.title_en: The fidelity measurement need not give optimal ROC points
visualizations.summary: Bodor 与 Koniorczyk（2017）问：在 Fuchs–Caves 保真度观测量的本征基里测量，按似然比依次累积得到的 d + 1 个 ROC 点，是否都在最优 ROC 曲线上？本库在 Lean 里给出三维反例并已冻结：ρ = (1/20)[[2,1,1],[1,10,1],[1,1,8]]，σ = DρD，D = diag(2, 1, ½)，效应 F = vv†/1382、v = (37, 2, −3) 在假阳性 1/10 处的真阳性 5539/13820 大于 2/5。页面用支撑线对偶算出最优曲线，画出它与保真度折线的差距，并在方向球面上显示最优效应与保真度本征基的偏离；非对角耦合 ε 为 0 时两态对易，差距消失。
visualizations.summary_en: Bodor and Koniorczyk (2017) asked whether the d + 1 ROC points obtained by measuring in the eigenbasis of the Fuchs–Caves fidelity observable and accumulating outcomes by likelihood ratio all lie on the optimal ROC curve. This library proves a three-dimensional counterexample in Lean, frozen: ρ = (1/20)[[2,1,1],[1,10,1],[1,1,8]], σ = DρD, D = diag(2, 1, ½), and the effect F = vv†/1382 with v = (37, 2, −3) has true-positive rate 5539/13820 > 2/5 at false-positive rate 1/10. The page computes the optimal curve by the supporting-line dual, draws its gap to the fidelity polyline, and shows on the sphere of directions how the optimal effect tilts away from the fidelity eigenbasis; at zero off-diagonal coupling ε the states commute and the gap vanishes.

visualizations.title: 2ⁿ 元域上的杨–巴克斯特元胞自动机周期整除 2ⁿ
visualizations.title_en: Yang–Baxter automata over a field of order 2ⁿ have period dividing 2ⁿ
visualizations.summary: Araoka 与 Tokihiro（2026）用 R 矩阵 R(x, y) = (y + f(x + y), x − f(x + y)) 沿一排格子运行、带螺旋边界的元胞自动机，并猜想：在 2ⁿ 元域上、f 为满足约化杨–巴克斯特方程的双射时，周期总整除 2ⁿ；他们证明了 4 与 8。本库在 Lean 里对所有 2ⁿ、所有格子数证明了 step^q = id 并已冻结：关键是这样的 f 总有平移对称 f(x + u) = f(x) + u。页面在 4、8、16 元域上运行自动机，把时空图绕成螺旋，穷举初态的周期分布，并给出一个不满足方程、周期为 6 与 10 的对照。
visualizations.summary_en: Araoka and Tokihiro (2026) run the R-matrix R(x, y) = (y + f(x + y), x − f(x + y)) along a row of cells with a helical boundary and conjectured that over a field of order 2ⁿ, for a bijective f solving the reduced Yang–Baxter equation, the period divides 2ⁿ; they proved the orders 4 and 8. This library proves step^q = id in Lean for every order 2ⁿ and every number of cells, frozen: the key is that such an f always has a translation symmetry f(x + u) = f(x) + u. The page runs the automaton over fields of order 4, 8 and 16, winds the space-time diagram into a helix, counts the periods of the initial states, and shows a contrasting f that fails the equation, with periods 6 and 10.

visualizations.title: 每个三能级都不满足条件，四能级仍有姆潘巴效应
visualizations.title_en: Every triplet fails the test, yet four levels show the Mpemba effect
visualizations.summary: Avitan、Factor、Gelbwaser-Klimovsky（2026）对马尔可夫姆潘巴效应给出三能级系统的必要条件 (3)，并猜想：若 N 能级系统的每个三能级子系统都不满足 (3)，它就没有姆潘巴效应。本库在 Lean 里给出四能级反例并已冻结：能量 (0, 1, 2, 64)·ln 16、浴温 β_b = 1，四个三能级子系统都不满足 (3)，−1 是单的慢模，而 x = 16^(−β) 取 1023/1024 的更热初态的慢模系数比 127/128 的更小。页面让两个初态同时弛豫，画出慢模系数随温度的驼峰与两条距离曲线在 t ≈ 4.28 的交叉，并让顶层能级 n 可调：只有 n ≥ 42 才有驼峰（页面数值与本页的论证）。
visualizations.summary_en: Avitan, Factor and Gelbwaser-Klimovsky (2026) gave a necessary condition (3) for the Markovian Mpemba effect in three-level systems and conjectured that an N-level system whose every triplet violates (3) shows no Mpemba effect. This library gives a four-level counterexample in Lean, frozen: energies (0, 1, 2, 64)·ln 16 and bath β_b = 1, every triplet violates (3), −1 is a simple slow mode, and the hotter start x = 16^(−β) = 1023/1024 has a smaller slow-mode coefficient than 127/128. The page relaxes the two starts side by side, draws the hump of the slow-mode coefficient against temperature and the crossing of the two distance curves at t ≈ 4.28, and lets the top level n vary: the hump exists only for n ≥ 42 (page numbers and the page’s argument).

visualizations.title: 最小优势骰子循环只在六面时刚好等于面数
visualizations.title_en: Minimal-advantage dice cycles are longest exactly at six faces
visualizations.summary: Easlick（2026，猜想 1）猜想：在每面取 1 到 n 的 n 面骰子里，每一步都以最小优势（n² 种掷法里赢 ⌊n²/2⌋ + 1 种）赢下一个的循环，最大长度恰好等于 n 只发生在 n = 6。本库在 Lean 里证明了这个猜想并已冻结：n = 6 时 462 颗骰子只有两个 7 颗骰子的结，结里有两颗骰子只能走向同一颗，所以循环至多 6，且六循环存在；n ≥ 7 时总有比 n 更长的循环。页面画出 n ≤ 7 的全部胜负图、两颗骰子对掷的 n² 种结果，并沿 Lean 核对过的循环一步步走。
visualizations.summary_en: Easlick (2026, Conjecture 1) conjectured that among n-sided dice with faces in 1 … n, cycles in which every die beats the next with the minimal advantage (⌊n²/2⌋ + 1 wins of n²) reach maximum length exactly n only for n = 6. This library proves the conjecture in Lean, frozen: the 462 six-sided dice form just two knots of 7 dice, in each of which two dice can only move to the same die, so cycles have at most 6 dice and a six-cycle exists; for every n ≥ 7 a cycle longer than n exists. The page draws the whole graph for n ≤ 7 and the n² outcomes of a duel, and walks the cycles that Lean checks step by step.

visualizations.title: 中间的测量比两个端点都好
visualizations.title_en: An intermediate measurement beats both endpoints
visualizations.summary: Zhou、Wu、Chau（2016，猜想 3 的第二个不等式）猜想：用测量 A′ 测 A 的误差加上它对 B 的扰动，在同一个态上取最坏值 Δ(A, A′, B)，总不小于两个端点中便宜的那个 f(A, B) = min{ε_rel(A, B), η(A, B)}。本库在 Lean 里证明这在三维不成立并已冻结：A = I、A′ = U、B = V 取有理正交矩阵，36 个半正定证书给出 Δ ≤ 71/250，两个见证态给出 f > 57/200。页面让 A′ 沿 SO(3) 上的路径从 A 走到 B，画出三组测量基、最坏的态与沿路的 Δ：经过 U 的路从 A 出发直到 t ≈ 0.54 都低于 f，直接的测地线上处处不低于 f（页面数值）。
visualizations.summary_en: Zhou, Wu and Chau (2016, second inequality of Conjecture 3) conjectured that the error of a measurement A′ in measuring A plus the disturbance it causes to B, maximized over one common state as Δ(A, A′, B), is never below the cheaper endpoint f(A, B) = min{ε_rel(A, B), η(A, B)}. This library proves in Lean that this fails in dimension three, frozen: with A = I, A′ = U and B = V rational orthogonal matrices, 36 semidefinite certificates give Δ ≤ 71/250 and two witness states give f > 57/200. The page moves A′ from A to B along paths on SO(3) and draws the three measurement bases, the worst state and Δ along the way: on the path through U it stays below f from A until t ≈ 0.54, along the direct geodesic Δ never drops below f (page numbers).

visualizations.title: 书图支配多项式根的猜想在正方形上不成立
visualizations.title_en: The book-graph domination root conjecture fails at the square
visualizations.summary: Rather（2026，猜想 5.4）猜想：书图 B_n（n 个四边形共用一条边）的支配多项式恰有四个实根——n 偶时二重根 0、一个小于 −2、一个在 (−1/2, 0)；n 奇时二重根 0 与两个在 (−1/2, 0)。本库在 Lean 里证明对全部 n ≥ 1 这不成立并已冻结：B₁ 就是四边形，D(C₄, x) = 6x² + 4x³ + x⁴ = x²((x + 2)² + 2) 除 0 外没有实根。页面画出书图与一个支配集、D/x² 的复根云，并对 n = 1 … 20 找出全部实根：n ≥ 2 时都符合猜想的模式（页面数值）。
visualizations.summary_en: Rather (2026, Conjecture 5.4) conjectured that the domination polynomial of the book B_n (n four-cycles sharing an edge) has exactly four real roots — 0 twice, one below −2 and one in (−1/2, 0) for even n, 0 twice and two in (−1/2, 0) for odd n. This library proves in Lean that this fails for the full range n ≥ 1, frozen: B₁ is the four-cycle and D(C₄, x) = 6x² + 4x³ + x⁴ = x²((x + 2)² + 2) has no real root besides 0. The page draws the book with a dominating set and the cloud of complex roots of D/x², and finds every real root for n = 1 … 20: from n = 2 on they follow the conjectured pattern (page numbers).

visualizations.title: 开放量子游走的赌徒破产：平均吸收时间需要 Im ρ₀₁
visualizations.title_en: Gambler’s ruin for open quantum walks: the mean absorption time needs Im ρ₀₁
visualizations.summary: Jacq 与 Lardizabal（2017）猜想：开放量子游走的赌徒破产问题里，从位置 k、内部态 ρ 出发的平均吸收时间总是 1 + h(M, M − k)ρ₀₀ + h(M, k)ρ₁₁ + j(M, k)·Re ρ₀₁，且 j(M, k) = −j(M, M − k)。本库在 Lean 里证明这对一般的复矩阵对不成立并已冻结：用 u = (1, i)、v = (1, −i) 搭出的一对 L、R，使 ρ 与 σ 的 ρ₀₀、ρ₁₁、Re ρ₀₁ 相同，平均吸收时间却是 1 与 2。页面画出游走在空间与时间里的展开、初始态 Bloch 球上的平均时间，并解出命中时间算子 A_k，画出猜想形式在每个 k 上要求为 0 的三个差。
visualizations.summary_en: Jacq and Lardizabal (2017) conjectured that in the gambler’s ruin of an open quantum walk the mean absorption time from site k with internal state ρ always equals 1 + h(M, M − k)ρ₀₀ + h(M, k)ρ₁₁ + j(M, k)·Re ρ₀₁ with j(M, k) = −j(M, M − k). This library proves in Lean that this fails for general complex pairs, frozen: a pair L, R built from u = (1, i) and v = (1, −i) gives two states ρ and σ with the same ρ₀₀, ρ₁₁ and Re ρ₀₁ but mean absorption times 1 and 2. The page shows the walk unfolding in space and time and the mean time over the Bloch ball of initial states, solves for the hitting-time operators A_k, and plots the three gaps the conjectured form needs to vanish at every k.

visualizations.summary: Halliwell 与 Mawby（2019）猜想：n 个二值量的成对概率表只要满足完整的 n 边形不等式与全部三时刻 Leggett–Garg 不等式，就有一个联合分布与之匹配。本库在 Lean 里证明 n = 6 时不成立并已冻结：时刻 6 与 1–4 的关联为 1/2、与 5 为 −1/2、其余为 0，条件全部成立，可权重 b = (1, 1, 1, 1, −1, −2) 让每个符号向量都有 W² ≥ 1，任何联合分布对 W² 的平均却必须是 −1。页面把关联乘以 t，画出各条件在哪里成立，并对 t ≤ 0.8 给出一个精确的联合分布。
visualizations.summary_en: Halliwell and Mawby (2019) conjectured that pair tables of n two-valued quantities have a matching joint law as soon as the full n-gon inequality and every three-time Leggett–Garg inequality hold. This library proves in Lean that this fails at n = 6, frozen: with time 6 correlated 1/2 with times 1–4, −1/2 with time 5 and all other correlations 0, every condition holds, yet the weights b = (1, 1, 1, 1, −1, −2) give W² ≥ 1 for every sign vector while any joint law would average W² to −1. The page scales the correlations by t, shows where each condition holds, and gives an exact joint law for t ≤ 0.8.

The proofs run both equations as automata reading k from the lowest bit and check finitely many state pairs. The page draws that product automaton (29, 15, 50 and 101 states), walks k through it and compares the two solution sets.

visualizations.summary: 一维格点上有限力程、平移不变的 Lindblad 生成元 t 作用在核 ρ ∈ ℓ²(ℤ × ℤ) 上。Klausen（2025）请人证明秩 1 跳跃时 0 ∈ σ(t)；本库在 Lean 里证明了它，不要求秩 1、H 自伴或耗散的符号，已冻结。机制是截断的迹：Σ_{|x|≤n} (tρ)(x, x) 只剩角上几个系数，有与 n 无关的界 K‖ρ‖，而 ‖P_n‖ = √(2n + 1) 无界增长，所以 t 没有有界逆。页面对三个生成元算出这些系数，并画出同一生成元在有限环上的谱。
visualizations.summary_en: A finite-range translation-invariant Lindblad generator t on a one-dimensional lattice acts on kernels ρ ∈ ℓ²(ℤ × ℤ). Klausen (2025) asked for a proof that 0 ∈ σ(t) for rank-one jumps; this library proves it in Lean, with no rank-one, self-adjointness or sign condition, frozen. The mechanism is the truncated trace: Σ_{|x|≤n} (tρ)(x, x) keeps only a few coefficients at the corners and is bounded by K‖ρ‖ uniformly in n, while ‖P_n‖ = √(2n + 1) grows without bound, so t has no bounded inverse. The page computes these coefficients for three generators and draws the spectrum of the same generator on a finite ring.

visualizations.summary: 在 [k]^d 棋盘上选点，任何一条完整直线（横、竖、斜方向连续 k 格）上都不能有 k − 1 个选中点，并且再也加不进新点。Ku（2026）猜想这样的配置最大能占 1 − 2/k 的格子。本库在 Lean 里证明 3×3×3 上最多 8 个点，少于猜想要求的 9 个，已冻结：9 个点会迫使一个 3 阶 Latin 方阵，而它的对角线必有重复，重复的两点落在同一条面对角线上。页面画出棋盘的全部直线，完全枚举小棋盘的饱和配置（3×3×3 的最大值只有 6），并逐个摆出 12 个 Latin 方阵演示障碍。

This library proves in Lean that 3×3×3 allows at most 8 points, fewer than the 9 the conjecture needs, frozen: 9 points would force a Latin square of order 3, whose diagonals must repeat a value, putting two points on one face diagonal. visualizations.summary: 一串两端固定、用 Lennard-Jones 势相连的粒子被拉长后，有些键会被拉过势的拐点而“断开”。Rodrigues、Kevrekidis 与 Dobson（2019）猜想：恰有 k 根断键的平衡态，力的雅可比矩阵有 k − 1 到 k 个正特征值，即 k − 1 到 k 对不稳定特征值。本库在 Lean 里证明了这个计数并已冻结。页面求出所有键张力相同的平衡，算出雅可比矩阵的谱，把同一个 d 上两支平衡的 k − 1 与 k 两个端点都画出来，并从平衡出发模拟非线性运动：三维视图里粒子的世界线组成时空图，断键标成品红。
visualizations.summary_en: Stretch a chain of particles joined by Lennard-Jones bonds between two fixed walls, and some bonds are pulled past the inflection point of the potential: they “break”. Rodrigues, Kevrekidis and Dobson (2019) conjectured that an equilibrium with exactly k broken bonds has between k − 1 and k positive eigenvalues of the force Jacobian, that is, between k − 1 and k unstable eigenvalue pairs. This library proves the count in Lean, frozen. The page solves the equilibria (every bond carries the same tension), computes the spectrum of the Jacobian, shows both endpoints k − 1 and k on the two branches of equilibria at one d, and simulates the nonlinear motion from each equilibrium: in the 3D view the world-lines of the particles form a space-time diagram with the broken bonds in magenta.

Arizmendi and Arizmendi conjectured that the Shapley value always lies in the core, that is, no set of vertices receives less than its worth. This library gives a counterexample in Lean, frozen: in the complete bipartite graph K₂,ₘ with m ≥ 50, the coalition that leaves out one scarce-side vertex receives less than its worth. visualizations.summary: Siudzińska（2020）用 d + 1 组互无偏基构造广义 Pauli 信道，每组基对应一个特征值；她在 d ≤ 5 算出四个特征值区域的体积，猜想三个比值公式：V_C/V_P = d/(d + 1)!，V_G/V_C = ((d² − 1)/d²)((d − 1)/d)^d，V_E/V_G = 1/(d + 1)。本库在 Lean 里对每个 d ≥ 2 证明了这三个公式，均已冻结；证明的关键是 C 为单纯形的仿射像、G 是两块单纯形之并、E 就是标准单纯形。页面画出 d = 2 时盒子里的四面体、双锥与单纯形，d = 3 时四维区域的三维截面（截面体积对 λ₄ 积分回到四维体积），并用随机取点核对更高维的比值。
visualizations.summary_en: Siudzińska (2020) built generalized Pauli channels from d + 1 mutually unbiased bases, one eigenvalue per basis; after computing the volumes of four eigenvalue regions for d ≤ 5 she conjectured three ratio formulas: V_C/V_P = d/(d + 1)!, V_G/V_C = ((d² − 1)/d²)((d − 1)/d)^d and V_E/V_G = 1/(d + 1). This library proves all three in Lean for every d ≥ 2, frozen; the key is that C is an affine image of a simplex, G is the union of two simplices, and E is the standard simplex. visualizations.title: 除数和能多接近 e^γ n log log n

visualizations.summary: Robin 比值 R(n) = σ(n)/(e^γ n log log n) 的上极限恰好是 1：本库在 Lean 里冻结了 Gronwall 的两条包络（从某处起 R ≤ 1 + ε；又有任意大的素数阶乘的幂使 R ≥ 1 − ε），以及 Robin 对数余量的下极限为 0；固定素数 p 的指数不超过 A 时，上限最终降到 1 − p^(−A−1)（已冻结）；ζ 若有实部大于 1/2 的零点，θ 的加权尾项会在任意晚的地方超过门槛 m/(|ρ||ρ − 1|)（已冻结）。页面把 σ(n) 筛到 10⁶，画出 n ≤ 5040 的 26 个 Robin 反例与按 p 的指数分层的包络，算出素数阶乘的幂怎样慢慢爬向 1/ζ(a + 1)，并用一对假想零点演示尾项的回声。黎曼猜想仍是开放问题。
visualizations.summary_en: The Robin ratio R(n) = σ(n)/(e^γ n log log n) has upper limit exactly 1: this library has frozen in Lean the two Gronwall envelopes (eventually R ≤ 1 + ε, and arbitrarily large primorial powers with R ≥ 1 − ε) and the lower limit 0 of the logarithmic Robin margin; when the exponent of a fixed prime p is at most A, the cap eventually drops to 1 − p^(−A−1) (frozen); and if ζ had a zero with real part above 1/2, a weighted tail of θ would exceed the threshold m/(|ρ||ρ − 1|) arbitrarily late (frozen). The page sieves σ(n) to 10⁶, marks the 26 Robin violations up to 5040 and the envelopes layered by the exponent of p, computes how primorial powers creep towards 1/ζ(a + 1), and uses one hypothetical zero pair to show the echo in the tail. The Riemann hypothesis remains open.

visualizations.title: 每一种取向都有 64 圈
visualizations.title_en: Every orientation has a 64-cycle
visualizations.summary: Erdős 与 Gyárfás 猜想最小度至少 3 的图都有长度为 2 的幂的圈。Garcia（2026）想用仿射群 AGL(1, 29) 与 AGL(1, 31) 上的三次凯莱图，把每个顶点按选定的取向换成 15 顶点的小部件，造出没有 4、8、16、32、64 圈的图，并留下一个搜索。本库在 Lean 里证明这个搜索无解，两个结果都已冻结：不论怎样取向，总有某个 14 圈的平移至少 10 次经过端口 u，于是能在小部件里绕出长度恰为 64 的简单圈。页面随机或按规则选取向，数出每个平移经过 u 的次数，验证恒等式 2S₄ + S₆ = 28N，并在替换图里逐边画出那个 64 圈。
visualizations.summary_en: Erdős and Gyárfás conjectured that every graph of minimum degree at least 3 has a cycle whose length is a power of two. Garcia (2026) tried to build a counterexample from cubic Cayley graphs on the affine groups AGL(1, 29) and AGL(1, 31), replacing each vertex by a 15-vertex gadget according to a chosen orientation so that no cycle has length 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64, and left a search open. This library proves in Lean that the search has no solution; both results are frozen. Whatever the orientation, some translate of a 14-cycle passes through port u at least 10 times, and the gadget then routes a simple cycle of length exactly 64. The page draws orientations at random or by rule, counts how often each translate passes through u, checks the identity 2S₄ + S₆ = 28N, and draws that 64-cycle edge by edge in the replacement graph.

visualizations.title: 一般位置：机器人、多项式与外部位置

visualizations.summary: 图上的一般位置：顶点集中没有三个点落在同一条最短路上。本库结算了三个相关问题，都已冻结：Klavžar 等人猜想柱面 C₇ □ Pₛ 与 C₁₀ □ Pₛ（s ≥ 5）的移动一般位置数是 4，已证明；Rather 问一般位置多项式 ψ(G) 何时只有实根，答案是连通图恰好在完全图时；Tian、Dokyeesun 与 Klavžar 关于删去非割点的外部一般位置上界被一个 19 个顶点的图推翻（8 > 5 + 2）。页面在三维里重放四个机器人走遍柱面的 Lean 构造、五个机器人只能上下移动的可达配置，从路加边到完全图时 ψ 的根，以及反例图上的五色阻挡。
visualizations.summary_en: General position in graphs: no three vertices of a set lie on a common shortest path. This library settles three related problems, all frozen: Klavžar et al. conjectured that the cylinders C₇ □ Pₛ and C₁₀ □ Pₛ (s ≥ 5) have mobile general position number 4, now proved; Rather asked when the general position polynomial ψ(G) is real-rooted, and for connected graphs the answer is exactly the complete graphs; and the outer general position bound of Tian, Dokyeesun and Klavžar under deletion of a non-cut vertex is refuted by a 19-vertex graph (8 > 5 + 2). visualizations.summary_en: How small can the unit sublevel set {|p| < 1} of a monic polynomial be? Ghosh and Ramachandran (2026) asked two questions, and this library answers both in the negative, frozen: on K = [−20, 20] the quartic Fekete polynomial (z² − 400)(z² − 80) has larger area than (z² − 400)(z² − 100), with both sides squeezed by certificate discs of rational radius; on K = the closed unit disc ∪ {4}, (zᴺ − 1)(z − 4)ᵏ with N = k² + 1 has area at most 20π·2⁻ᵏ, so the minimal area is neither Θ(1/n) nor Θ(1/log n). The page draws log|p| as a surface, sweeps the competitor's inner root, magnifies the tiny discs near each root with the Lean certificate circles, and unrolls the petals near the unit circle inside the annulus 1 ± 2⁻ᵏ.

visualizations.summary_en: Coordination games on a network: imitators copy their best-earning neighbour, best responders pick the strategy better for themselves. Hasheminejad and Ramazi (2023) proved that mixed populations equilibrate on several network classes and asked whether general graphs do too. This library has a frozen counterexample: K₄ minus one edge, one best responder and three imitators, which from BABB under the schedule 2, 0, 3, 1 repeated cycles every 8 steps and never reaches the equilibria AAAA or BBBB. The page draws the network with its utilities, the four-dimensional cube of the 16 states with the 8-cycle inside it, a space-time chart and the payoff tables; each agent's rule can be switched (only the counterexample's assignment out of 16 cycles), and random activation can be compared (all 2000 simulated runs settle quickly).

visualizations.summary: Gupta（2026）把 m × n Miura-ori 的折法写成网格上的高度函数：相邻格高度恰差 1，翻转一个严格局部极值就是翻转图的一条边。他的两个问题本库都已证明：任何整数 1-Lipschitz 函数的离散度不超过斜坡 i + j 的离散度 D(m, n)（不等式 (4)，由此翻转图直径为 D(m, n)），以及极值个数固定、极小值不全在同一边上的高度函数个数是总次数至多 d − 3 的多项式（猜想 8.3）。页面画出高度地形、一条从 −A 到 A 恰好 D(m, n) 步的翻转路（小网格上用广度优先搜索核对直径）、离散度与最优中心，以及证明里先排行再排列的重排。
visualizations.summary_en: Gupta (2026) writes the foldings of the m × n Miura-ori as height functions on the grid: neighbouring heights differ by exactly 1, and flipping a strict local extremum is one edge of the flip graph. This library proves two of his questions: every integer 1-Lipschitz function has dispersion at most D(m, n), that of the ramp i + j (inequality (4), which makes the flip-graph diameter D(m, n)), and with the number of extrema fixed, the height functions whose minima are not all on one side are counted by a polynomial of total degree at most d − 3 (Conjecture 8.3). The page draws the height terrain, a flip path of exactly D(m, n) steps from −A to A (with the diameter checked by breadth-first search on small grids), the dispersion with its best centre, and the proof's rearrangement that sorts rows and then columns.

visualizations.title: 树上的单位圆 · 何时守住、何时破开
visualizations.title_en: The unit circle on trees: when it holds, when it breaks
visualizations.summary: Lee 与 Yang 证明铁磁 Ising 模型的配分函数零点都在单位圆上。Fiol、Martínez-Montoya、Rios Fukelman（2020）猜想树上的一族同类多项式也是如此，对任意正的分法权重都成立。本库给出两个已冻结的反例：三点路径配联合权重 W₃₁，以及原文物理权重下的九点双中心树（离圆只有约 0.002）。但对“两条边总数 3、其余 2”把所有放法加起来，任何树的根都回到单位圆上，这一点也已冻结。页面在复平面上把离圆的距离放大画出：权重 M 增大时根在 M = 31 离开圆；放大倍数升到几百倍时，物理反例才显形；逐个加入放法时，根沿着圆移动；有的放法单独看会离圆，加完之后的和全部在圆上。
visualizations.summary_en: Lee and Yang proved that the partition function of a ferromagnetic Ising model has all its zeros on the unit circle. Fiol, Martínez-Montoya and Rios Fukelman (2020) conjectured the same for a family of such polynomials on trees, with any positive split weights. This library has two frozen counterexamples: the three-vertex path with joint weights W₃₁, and a nine-vertex double hub under the source’s physical weights (only about 0.002 off the circle). Yet summing all placements of “two edges with total 3, the rest 2” brings every root back to the unit circle on every tree, which is frozen as well. The page draws the complex plane with the distance from the circle magnified: as the weight M grows the roots leave the circle at M = 31; the physical counterexample appears only at a magnification of a few hundred; and as placements are added one by one the roots move along the circle; some placements leave it on their own, while the full sum lies entirely on it.

The page computes Grundy tables with the 2-adic rule for losing positions, the probability sequences with the window sum the proof conserves, and exact minimax game values; you can play the cordiality game yourself.

visualizations.summary_en: Cut a prefix of an infinite word into as few palindromes as possible; the least number of pieces is the prefix palindromic length P(n). The page computes P(n) with a palindromic tree for the first 300 000 prefixes of the period-doubling word and the first 100 000 of the Fibonacci word, and draws optimal cuts as arches. For the period-doubling word this library proves Conjecture 17 of Frid, Laborde and Peltomäki (2021): the differences are not 2-automatic and P is not 2-regular, together with the signed-binary lower bound P(n) ≥ F(n) and exact values at sparse addresses. For the Fibonacci word it proves Frid’s 2018 conjecture: the prefix of length F₆ₖ₊₃/2 needs exactly 2k + 1 palindromes.

visualizations.title_en: The uncertainty ledger · where the price of non-commuting is booked
visualizations.summary: ΔA²·ΔB² 恰好分成三笔：协方差、对易子项、非负的 Gram 余项（本库冻结的 Robertson–Schrödinger 恒等式）。布洛赫球上，纯量子比特的余项总是 0，混合态的余项正好是 |a×b|²(1 − |r|²)；自旋 j 在单轴扭转下，账从对易子挪到协方差再挪进余项，猫态时全在余项。然后在 d + 1 组互无偏基上核对碰撞守恒 Σp² = 1 + tr ρ² 与冻结的熵不确定关系，并数值搜索最小熵和：d = 3 时恰好取到下界。
visualizations.summary_en: ΔA²·ΔB² splits exactly into three entries: the covariance, the commutator term and a non-negative Gram remainder (the Robertson–Schrödinger identity frozen in this library). On the Bloch ball the remainder of a pure qubit is always 0, and for a mixed state it is exactly |a×b|²(1 − |r|²); for spin j under one-axis twisting the balance moves from the commutator to the covariance and then into the remainder, which holds all of it for a cat state. Then the page checks collision conservation Σp² = 1 + tr ρ² and the frozen entropic uncertainty relation on d + 1 mutually unbiased bases, and searches numerically for the least entropy sum: in d = 3 it reaches the bound exactly.

The page shows five published conjectures and questions this library has refuted or answered: Song and Lin's parity conjecture for zero transfer, the universal-transfer conjecture of Connelly et al., Kay's transfer-rate conjecture, the converse asked by Kirkland et al. for interior transfer (a weighted five-site path transfers inside but never between its ends), and the tree conjecture of Coutinho and Baptista (a 17-vertex tree transfers perfectly under the normalized Laplacian).

visualizations.title_en: A fourth mutually unbiased basis in dimension six · an open problem
visualizations.summary: 两组基互无偏，是说一组里的任何态拿去按另一组测，每个结果的概率都是 1/d。素数维有 d + 1 组；六维只构造出 3 组，第四组存不存在至今没有证明。页面用同一个梯度下降在 3、5、7 维里找到第四组，在六维里停住，连一个与已知三组都无偏的向量也找不到。这只是数值线索；本库已冻结的是归约和若干分支的排除。新增的判据视图把已知三组基当作纠缠判据：本库证明了 Tavakoli–Morelli 的不完全互无偏基 Schmidt 数界，用三组基能在可见度 v > 1/3 时证出纠缠，若有第四组门槛可降到 1/4。
visualizations.summary_en: Two bases are mutually unbiased when every state of one, measured in the other, gives each outcome with probability 1/d. Prime dimensions have d + 1 of them; in dimension six only 3 have been constructed, and whether a fourth exists is still unproved. One gradient descent finds a fourth basis in dimensions 3, 5 and 7 and stalls in six, where it cannot find even one vector unbiased to the known three. That is only a numerical lead; what the library has frozen is a reduction and the exclusion of some branches. A witness view uses the known three bases as an entanglement witness: this library proved the Schmidt-number bound of Tavakoli and Morelli for incomplete sets of mutually unbiased bases, and three bases certify entanglement for visibility v > 1/3, where a fourth basis would lower the threshold to 1/4.

visualizations.summary_en: Two qubits can make orthogonal wholes while each side holds exactly the same state: the Bell state is pure, yet either half alone is the completely mixed I/2. The correlation sector that neither side can read alone takes up 9 of the 15 directions of two qubits. Teleportation uses exactly this correlation: resources whose halves are identical teleport with fidelity anywhere from 1/3 to 1, and classical correlation reaches only 2/3.

visualizations.summary: 谐振子的能级是 ħω(n + ½) 的等距阶梯，本征态是厄米函数：基态能量不为零，相干态像经典小球一样来回摆，每个周期精确复原；二维时频率比是有理数，轨道才闭合。厄米函数两两正交、合起来能拼出任何形状，但方盒、三角这类有跳跃或尖角的形状，能量加权的系数平方和发散，哈密顿量作用不上去。
visualizations.summary_en: The oscillator's energies form the evenly spaced ladder ħω(n + ½) and its eigenstates are Hermite functions: the ground-state energy is not zero, a coherent state swings like a classical ball and returns exactly every period, and in 2D the orbit closes only when the frequency ratio is rational. The Hermite functions are orthonormal and together build any shape, but for shapes with jumps or corners, such as a box or a triangle, the energy-weighted sum of squared coefficients diverges and the Hamiltonian cannot act on them.

visualizations.summary_en: A qubit can be measured along only one direction at a time, and each result is just ±1. Measuring along Z alone, the phase is completely invisible and the states with the same statistics fill a whole disc; adding X leaves a chord; only the three complementary directions X, Y and Z determine the state. The purity splits exactly into the squared probability deviations of the directions plus an invisible residual. A single sample can be neither read completely nor copied.

visualizations.title: 量子纠错 · 离开编码空间不等于丢了信息
visualizations.title_en: Quantum error correction · leaving the code space is not losing the information
visualizations.summary: 三比特重复码把一个逻辑比特写成 α|000⟩ + β|111⟩。噪声把态推出编码空间，落进三份两两正交的错误副本；把副本折回来，哪怕整个态都离开了编码空间、哪怕错误是相干叠加，也能精确找回。两个比特同时翻转会骗过译码：Knill–Laflamme 条件不成立。各分支沿路径带回的相位要靠记录补偿，记录被删掉一位，最优误差就从 0 跳上去。
visualizations.summary_en: The three-qubit repetition code writes one logical qubit as α|000⟩ + β|111⟩. Noise pushes the state out of the code space into three mutually orthogonal error copies; folding the copies back recovers the state exactly, even when the whole state has left the code space and even when the error is a coherent superposition. Two simultaneous flips fool the decoder: the Knill–Laflamme condition fails. Phases that the branches bring back along their paths must be undone from the record, and deleting one record bit raises the best error above 0.

visualizations.summary_en: A quantum particle walks on a ring or a chain while a detector checks one site every τ. A classical random walker is always found in the end; part of a quantum walker can lie in the dark space, standing waves that cancel at the detector, and is never detected. At special detection intervals the dark space suddenly grows; starting at the detector, the mean return round is an integer.

visualizations.summary_en: A Rabi-driven qubit is refreshed again and again while it flips: the denser the refreshes, the harder the flip. A refresh is a physical interaction, so it can do more: incomplete records only weaken the freeze, refreshes that weaken with the interval merely slow the transition down, a slowly turning measurement drags the state to an orthogonal position, and for an unstable state decaying into an environment a moderate measurement rate speeds the decay up.
